Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/capstonenext && python3 - <<'PY'
import os, random, subprocess, sys, time
random.seed(2)
platforms=[28,29,30,31,32,44,45,26,27,46]
start=time.time()
special=[bytes([p])+bytes(x) for p in platforms for x in ([0x41,0],[0x42,0],[0x43,0,0,0,0],[0x44,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0],[0x28,0,0],[0x0e,0,0],[0x10,0],[0x11,0,0],[0x20,0],[0x3f,0],[0x40,0])]
for it in range(100000):
    if it < len(special): data=bytearray(special[it])
    else:
        p=random.choice(platforms)
        L=random.choice([2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10,12,16,24])
        data=bytearray([p])+bytearray(os.urandom(L-1))
        if p==28 and random.random()<0.7:
            op=random.choice([0,1,2,3,4,5,0xb,0xc,0xd,0xe,0xf,0x10,0x11,0x1a,0x1b,0x20,0x21,0x22,0x23,0x24,0x28,0x29,0x36,0x37,0x3f,0x40,0x41,0x42,0x43,0x44])
            data[1]=op
    open('/tmp/capfuzz','wb').write(data)
    r=subprocess.run(['./build/fuzz_disasm','/tmp/capfuzz'], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=2)
    e=r.stderr
    if r.returncode!=0 or b'use-of-uninitialized' in e or (b'MemorySanitizer' in e and b'init done' not in e):
        print('FOUND',it,'rc',r.returncode,'len',len(data),'hex',bytes(data).hex())
        print(e[:4000].decode('latin1','replace'))
        sys.exit(0)
    if it and it%10000==0: print('iter',it,'rate',it/(time.time()-start), file=sys.stderr)
print('none')
PY
